_comment: Response body for GET /api/site/overview, the endpoint app/page.tsx reads on mount.
Every figure below is copied from metadata.json, and the exact key is named on each
entry so a reader can check it rather than take it. They are committed here rather
than computed so the capture is reproducible: screenshot.png is captured against
exactly this payload, and a recapture only moves pixels when the UI actually changed.
metadata.json is the authority. When a stat moves there it has to move here too, and
the screenshot has to be recaptured in the same commit — CLAUDE.md names drifting
counts as this repo's single most repeated defect, and this page is one more place
Shape is fixed by PlatformMetric, exported from components/MetricsStrip.tsx.
